storyboard.concept: One strip from the original three-strip run: gating chooses a function, but it also changes a named declaration into a const initializer. Read the transcript for the source-backed boundary.

strips.limitation: Metaphor for named-declaration gating. Default exports and function expressions have different replacement forms; this is not a complete treatment of JavaScript hoisting.
